findings.reason: the table's conclusion (codex is lower on every dimension, clive's weak one is durability) holds identically on the 18-row set, so the off-by-one changes no node's work, only the stated endpoint's accuracy.
findings.text: the Why states the table is the pick-filtered set "over the 14 days to 2026-10-18 06:25 UTC", but at that endpoint nova's run store yields 18 rows / 15 fully scored / 13 totals for clive with reuse median 18.0, not the 17 / 14 / 12 and reuse 18.5 the table prints; the pick's own filters (role implement, spec exact, requirement deep/critical, `_picked_backend_away`) reproduce 18, and none of the excluded candidate rows (`owner-cell-current` completed 06:23:17Z, `axis-facing-owner`, `saddle-anchored-expansion`) is a move, so no declared filter explains the drop — the set matches only by cutting the read at ~06:22, before `owner-cell-current` landed
